name: netlab
what_it_is: netlab is an infrastructure-as-code tool for virtual networking labs that converts high-level YAML topology descriptions into fully configured lab environments. It generates Vagrantfile, containerlab topology files, Ansible inventory, IPv4/IPv6 addressing plans, and deploys device configurations automatically.
components: topology graph generator (Graphviz and D2 formats)
measurement: routing reports (BGP, IS-IS, OSPF adjacencies and prefixes)
link impairment parameters (delay, loss, bandwidth via netlab tc)
packet captures on VM and container interfaces
configuration: YAML lab topology file (nodes, links, protocols, addressing)
system defaults via netlab defaults command
custom Jinja2 configuration templates per device type
PIP_OPTIONS build argument for package installation
fault_injection: link impairment via netlab tc (delay, packet loss, bandwidth limiting using Linux netem)
constraints: requires external lab runtime: either libvirt/KVM with Vagrant or Docker with containerlab — netlab does not include a built-in hypervisor or container engine
network device images (VM or container) must be separately obtained and installed; netlab does not provide or bundle device images
Ansible is required for device configuration deployment; without it, configuration generation is possible but not deployment
devcontainer Dockerfile is based on Python 3.11 on Debian Bookworm — other base OS combinations are not officially provided
link impairment (netlab tc) relies on Linux kernel netem, so it is only functional on Linux hosts or Linux-based container environments
notable_absences: no built-in GUI or web dashboard — topology visualization is output-only (Graphviz/D2 files)
no bundled network device images — users must supply vendor OS images separately
no docker-compose.yml — the project ships only a devcontainer Dockerfile, not a multi-service compose stack
no real-time telemetry streaming or SNMP collection built in
no Windows-native support — designed for Linux environments (KVM or Docker on Linux)
